The term and formula grammar supports string equality, append, length and emptiness, but no lexicographic comparison or sorting operation.","attempted_representations":["A total fold over events can remove duplicate group names using string equality and filtering, but insertion into lexicographic order requires an unavailable string comparison.","An exact String representation preserves group names, but length and equality cannot determine lexicographic order. Requiring presorted input would add an unauthorized caller assumption."]},{"obligation_ids":["O2","O3","O4","O5","I1"],"feature":"Generation of an unbounded bucket sequence from integer bounds","reason":"The number of emitted buckets depends on end-start and width and can be arbitrarily large even for a single input event. The grammar has no integer range generation, recursion or iteration bounded by a numeric term. Therefore it cannot construct the required output list of all bucket starts strictly below end or carry previous values through that sequence.","attempted_representations":["Supported list folds can aggregate event occurrences and maintain accumulator records, but they iterate only over existing lists. A single event does not supply a list whose length covers an arbitrarily large number of buckets.","List append and list construction inside finitely nested total folds can expand lists, but for a fixed one-event input their output lengths remain bounded independently of end and width.","Adding a caller-provided bucket list or replacing integer bounds with a list would change the required Input fields and types."]}]}
